en: Color lithographed street view of the old town with an iron-railed bridge leading into a square. A clock tower rises over tiled roofs; ornate Baroque façades flank a lamppost. Captions read "Kleiner Ring" and "Alt‑Hermannstadt," with artist credit "gez. v. Trude Schullerus." The reverse is a divided back marked in Hungarian "LEVELEZŐ‑LAP," with a purple circular stamp from Brukenthal's Museum in Hermannstadt and a date stamp 7 JULI 1917.
